observed.markup_note: only the text above was relayed; the markup around it was not captured, so the proof serves the text as text/html (a body that is not JSON is all the hook sees)
observed.second_patch_note: sent after a GET; the first save had changed the map, so this is the map's new tag as the GET gave it, weakened

read: Studio's route passes the check and writes; Vercel's edge then applies the request's If-Match to the function's RESPONSE, whose ETag changed with the write, and swaps in its own 412
get_path: the browser's reads use fetch cache 'no-store' (components/model-choice/use-model-choice.ts routeFetch), so they carry no If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since for the edge to turn into a 304; the route answers Cache-Control: no-store
